start.title: [TODO:tr] Pharaoh's Decree
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Soldiers shout in the streets.
"Every Hebrew son must die."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Hand the baby to a soldier

hand_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] No, Never
hand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Your arms tighten around him.
God did not give him to be killed.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Too Dangerous
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The desert by night is no place
for a newborn. Stay. Hide him.

hide_home.title: [TODO:tr] Three Months Hidden
hide_home.text:
[TODO:tr] You nurse him in silence.
Every cry could end his life.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Each day is a small miracle.

show_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Silence Saves Him
show_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] A loud word could reach the guards.
Guard him in quiet.

growing_baby.title: [TODO:tr] He Grows
growing_baby.text:
[TODO:tr] He is too big to hide much longer.
His cries fill the small room.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] He needs air, not a grave.

bury_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Not That Way
bury_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Despair cannot save him.
Kneel and ask the God of your fathers.

prayer.title: [TODO:tr] A Quiet Plea
prayer.text:
[TODO:tr] "God of Abraham, save my son."
A thought stirs: the river. The reeds.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Trust the Whisper
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] God speaks softly to faithful hearts.
Do not silence Him now.

weave_basket.title: [TODO:tr] Papyrus and Pitch
weave_basket.text:
[TODO:tr] You weave through the night.
Tar and pitch will keep him dry.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] It will float and stay sealed.

clay_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Not Clay
clay_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Only pitch can keep the river out.
Seal it carefully.

miriam_called.title: [TODO:tr] Miriam, Your Daughter
miriam_called.text:
[TODO:tr] Your daughter watches you wide-eyed.
"Mother, what are you doing?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She is your ally, not enemy.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Tell her to come with you
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She nods, brave like her mother.

anger_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Not Now
anger_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She is small but faithful.
You will need her at the river.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She slips her hand into yours.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Truth, Gently
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] A lie cannot guard her brother.
Tell her plainly. Trust her.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Her chin lifts. She is ready.

to_river.title: [TODO:tr] To the Reeds
to_river.text:
[TODO:tr] Before dawn, you slip out the door.
The Nile breathes mist ahead.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Throw him into the open river
[TODO:tr] Hide the basket in the reeds

throw_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Among the Reeds
throw_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He must rest where the water is still.
God chose this place for a reason.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Place him gently in the reeds

place_basket.title: [TODO:tr] The Hardest Goodbye
place_basket.text:
[TODO:tr] You lower the basket into the reeds.
His tiny breath rises and falls.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Snatch him back and run home
[TODO:tr] Whisper a blessing and step back

snatch_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Trust God Now
snatch_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] If you take him home, he will die.
The river is his only path.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Bless him and let him go

miriam_watch.title: [TODO:tr] Miriam Stays
miriam_watch.text:
[TODO:tr] You leave Miriam to keep watch.
"Stay hidden. See what becomes of him."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Order her to swim with the basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She would drown in the current.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Tell her to hide and watch

swim_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Watch From Shore
swim_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] She is a child. She must hide and pray.
God will move others.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Tell her to watch from the reeds

princess_arrives.title: [TODO:tr] Royal Footsteps
princess_arrives.text:
[TODO:tr] Sandals on stone. Silk on the wind.
Pharaoh's daughter comes to bathe.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Throw a stone to scare her off
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] She is the answer, not the threat.

stone_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Do Not Interfere
stone_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] God is opening a door no one expected.
Do not slam it shut.

she_sees.title: [TODO:tr] She Sees the Basket
she_sees.text:
[TODO:tr] She points among the reeds.
"Bring me that basket."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your heart pounds in the reeds.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Silence is Wiser
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] A shout would expose everything.
Let the moment unfold.

she_opens.title: [TODO:tr] A Hebrew Child
she_opens.text:
[TODO:tr] She lifts the lid. He cries.
"He is one of the Hebrew babies."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Whisper a blessing for her heart

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Wait. The right moment will come.

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Wait For It
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Compassion is rising in her heart.
Do not rush God's work.

compassion.title: [TODO:tr] Pity Moves Her
compassion.text:
[TODO:tr] She holds him close, tears in her eyes.
"I will keep him for my own."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Send Miriam to offer a nurse

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] God placed her here for this.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Speak Now, Daughter
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] This is why she was put here.
Let her step forward in faith.

miriam_offers.title: [TODO:tr] A Brave Little Voice
miriam_offers.text:
[TODO:tr] Miriam steps out. "Shall I find
a Hebrew nurse for the child?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] He must come back to you.

egyptian_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Belongs With You
egyptian_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] God arranged his return to your arms.
Do not turn from the gift.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wait for the princess to answer

yes_go.title: [TODO:tr] Run, Miriam
yes_go.text:
[TODO:tr] Miriam runs through the reeds.
She finds you trembling and waiting.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Refuse to come, hiding in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] God is giving him back. Go.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Come at once to the princess
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You wipe your eyes and run.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Step Forward
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Faith now means meeting her face to face.
God has gone before you.

before_princess.title: [TODO:tr] Before the Princess
before_princess.text:
[TODO:tr] You bow low at the river's edge.
She places your son in your arms.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Confess that you are his mother
[TODO:tr] Accept the wages and the child

confess_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Hold Your Tongue
confess_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Telling now could end it all.
Receive the gift God prepared.

wages.title: [TODO:tr] Paid to Mother Him
wages.text:
[TODO:tr] She pays you to nurse your own son.
God has done the impossible.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Refuse the wages out of pride
[TODO:tr] Take him home and raise him

pride_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Receive the Blessing
pride_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] God's provision is not to be refused.
Take the silver and your son.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You walk home weeping with joy.

home_again.title: [TODO:tr] Years of Whispered Songs
home_again.text:
[TODO:tr] You sing the songs of Abraham,
of Isaac, of Jacob — into his ear.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Hide him forever from the palace
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] He has a calling beyond home.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Prepare him to return to her
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You teach him who he truly is.

hide_forever_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Belongs to God
hide_forever_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He was given to you for a season.
Now give him back to His purpose.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You braid his hair with prayers.

return_palace.title: [TODO:tr] Back to the Princess
return_palace.text:
[TODO:tr] He is weaned. The day has come.
You walk him to the palace gates.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Run away with him at the last
choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Trust the God who saved him.
[TODO:tr] She receives him as her son.

runaway_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Let Him Go
runaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] God has a great work for him.
Do not hold him back from it.

named_moses.title: [TODO:tr] She Names Him Moses
named_moses.text:
[TODO:tr] "I drew him out of the water."
Moses. The drawn-out one.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] A Saved Deliverer
ending.text:
[TODO:tr] You saved a baby from the river.
God is raising a deliverer for His people.
